evidence.citation: “Stop and clarify the bar before running any evaluation.” The artifact limits pre-run work to defining outcome criteria, observable failure signals, and whether the template is mandatory, then confirming that bar before blind runs.
evidence.criterion: C1: The artifact does not require materially unnecessary execution work under the supplied cost evaluation bar.

rationale: The required clarification establishes evaluation validity and prevents spending runs against an undefined or improperly template-driven bar. Under the supplied cost bar, work that establishes fixture validity and protects evaluation integrity is necessary, not a cost regression.
